name: Remove Background AI
author: RemBG

sections.description:
Remove Background AI is a powerful WordPress block that automatically removes backgrounds from images using advanced AI technology. Perfect for bloggers, e-commerce stores, content creators, and anyone who needs professional-looking images without design skills.

How It Works

  1. Install & Configure: Install the plugin and get your free API key from www.rembg.com
  2. Add the Block: In the block editor, search for “Remove Background” and add the block
  3. Upload Image: Simply upload any image you want to edit
  4. AI Processing: The plugin automatically removes the background using AI
  5. Done: Your image is ready to use – save and publish!

Features

  • One-click background removal – No design skills required
  • High-quality AI results – Professional-grade background removal
  • Easy integration – Works seamlessly with the WordPress block editor
  • Fast processing – Get results in seconds
  • Perfect for e-commerce – Clean product photos instantly
  • Great for content – Professional images for blogs and social media

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • Free API key from www.rembg.com
  • Images are processed by the RemBG.com AI service

Privacy Notice

This plugin sends uploaded images to www.rembg.com for background removal processing. Images are processed by a third-party AI service and may be temporarily stored on their servers. Please review their privacy policy before use.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/remove-background-ai directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Remove Background AI in your admin menu
  4. Get your free API key from www.rembg.com
  5. Enter your API key in the plugin settings
  6. Start using the “Remove Background” block in the editor!
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for the API key?

No! You can get a free API key from www.rembg.com. They offer free credits for testing and reasonable pricing for production use.

How long does it take to process an image?

Most images are processed within 1-8 seconds, depending on the image size and server load.

What image formats are supported?

The plugin supports all common image formats including JPG, PNG, and WebP.

Is my image data secure?

Images are sent to www.rembg.com for processing, We do not use Images for training: https://www.rembg.com/en/privacy
